atAGlance: Cơm chiên gà is chicken fried rice, usually with egg, chicken, scallion, vegetables, and soy-seasoned rice.
whatItIs: Cơm chiên gà is chicken fried rice with egg, scallions, garlic, and small pieces of chicken. It is a steady, filling order when you want familiar flavors in a Vietnamese shop.
howToEnjoy: Eat it while the rice is hot and separate-grained. A little chili or soy-lime seasoning is enough; the chicken and wok aroma should stay in front.
howLocalsOrder: Order cơm chiên gà when you want a simple chicken fried rice. Ask for less oil, no chili, or a fried egg before the wok starts.
worthKnowing: Fried rice in Vietnam is often cooked quickly to order, so oil level, chili, and egg are the easiest adjustments to request.
goodToKnow: Order this when you want something straightforward and filling. The best versions taste of hot wok, egg, chicken, and scallion rather than a separate condiment.
